name: archive-lens
title_zh: 网页文章存档后自动生成无干扰阅读视图和三要点摘要
tagline_zh: 付费墙、弹窗、广告页——存下来就变纯净排版。Unpaywall 自动解锁，AI 只给你三条要点，不啰嗦。
tagline_en: Paywalls, pop-ups, clutter—archived into a clean reader view. Unpaywall unlocks, AI distills to 3 bullets. No.
desc_en: Archive and unpaywall web articles, generate distraction-free AI Reader Views, and extract 3-bullet AI summaries using VPS Archive Lens.
why_zh: 它把存档、解锁、提炼压成一条流水线：存的是原文，看的是净版，记的是三颗子弹。不打断阅读流。
why_en: One pipeline: archive raw, read clean, remember 3 bullets. No tab-hopping, no context switching—just a straight shot from save.
limit_zh: 只处理可公开访问的网页；Unpaywall 仅覆盖有 DOI 的学术文献，其他付费墙打不开。摘要依赖远端 AI 服务。
limit_en: Public web pages only; Unpaywall works solely for DOI-registered papers. AI summary needs remote API key—offline, you get reader view only.
title_en: Archive web articles, get clean reader view & 3-bullet AI.
